skipped.reason: no card in Forge's cardsfolder has more than one instance of casualty, so independent payment of several instances cannot be reached in a game

scenarios.title: Paying the casualty cost copies the spell

setup.notes: Cut Your Losses has casualty 2. B's library holds 20 cards. Grizzly Bears has power 2; Memnite has power 1.

decisions: A casts Cut Your Losses, tapping six Islands, targeting player B, and pays its casualty cost by sacrificing Grizzly Bears.
The casualty trigger goes on the stack above the spell; A keeps B as the target of the copy.
Both players pass; the copy resolves, then Cut Your Losses resolves.

variants.label: sacrifice_bears
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears moves to A's graveyard as a cost. The casualty trigger fires and creates a copy. The copy makes B mill 10 (half of 20) and the original then makes B mill 5 (half of 10): B's library holds 5 cards.

variants.label: casualty_declined
variants.delta: A does not pay the casualty cost and sacrifices nothing.
variants.expected: No casualty trigger fires and no copy is created. Grizzly Bears stays on the battlefield. Cut Your Losses makes B mill 10: B's library holds 10 cards.

variants.label: power_too_low
variants.delta: A controls Memnite (power 1) instead of Grizzly Bears (power 2).
variants.expected: Memnite is not a legal sacrifice for casualty 2, so the casualty cost cannot be paid and A casts Cut Your Losses without it. No casualty trigger fires and no copy is created. Memnite stays on the battlefield. Cut Your Losses makes B mill 10: B's library holds 10 cards.

scenarios.forge_notes: The scenario fixes the copy's target as B. Forge's casualty is an optional additional cost.
